description: Implementation of the SI (System Information) scheduler for 5G NR, managing scheduling, SI change requests, and short message allocations within a cellular network simulation or system.

classes.name: si_scheduler
classes.description: Class responsible for scheduling System Information (SI) messages, handling SI change requests, and managing SI-related signaling in a 5G NR system.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Executes scheduling logic for a given slot, including handling pending requests and scheduling SI messages.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the scheduler, resets state, and stops ongoing SI scheduling activities.

methods.name: handle_pending_request
methods.description: Handles pending SI change requests, scheduling short messages or applying updates as appropriate.

methods.name: handle_si_update_request
methods.description: Receives and stores new SI scheduling update requests.

methods.name: try_schedule_short_message
methods.description: Attempts to schedule a short SI message in the current slot if conditions permit.

methods.name: allocate_short_message
methods.description: Allocates resources for a short SI message and prepares the DCI for paging.
